title: Optical voltage trace to independently recorded spike timing across complete cell recordings
scientific_question: Can a general model recover electrophysiologically verified spike events from a fixed optical voltage trace in a neuron and animal excluded from fitting?
participant_inputs: Per-cell fluorescence trace extracted from all frames using a fixed label-independent ROI/motion/background recipe, optical timestamps and acquisition-quality masks; include known indicator polarity and frame exposure, never patch voltage, spike annotations, cell-specific optimum threshold, or answer-tuned ROI.
known_answer: All electrophysiologically measured spike events aligned to camera exposure. Independent evaluator fixes spike detection/quality exclusions from patch records before predictions; ambiguous or saturated patch intervals remain explicitly unscorable with coverage.
complete_scope: All12 deposited cells and every recording/movie within each cell, not the three examples from the VolPy method comparison. Optical mask/extraction quality must be audited independently of spike prediction. Include low-SNR and failed-extraction records as failures/coverage, not silently remove them.
protected_split: After authentic mouse→cell→movie mapping, grouped leave-one-animal-out development folds; all movies/cells of a mouse stay together. A secondary leave-cell-out result may be reported separately and never called animal generalization. Six title tokens are not independently authenticated animals.
input_representation: A new derived-trace task, not video segmentation: retain the complete optical time series at original400/1000Hz, including missingness. Deterministic nonoverlapping one-second scored cores may carry two-sided one-second context halos; every frame/event is scored once with boundary ownership fixed by timestamp. The same complete tile roster goes to all arms. Halo is retrospective context, not a causal online claim. No subthreshold samples, hard movies or low-activity periods may be discarded to fit context.

scoring.primary: One-to-one spike-event F1 at fixed5ms tolerance in physical time; aggregate counts over all tiles of a movie before cell and authenticated-animal summaries. Max-cardinality matching prevents double credit.
scoring.secondary: Precision, recall, event latency, false events/minute, full duration and electrode/optical validity coverage; report400Hz and1kHz strata.
scoring.edge_cases: No-spike cases have explicit false-alarm burden; no empty/empty perfect-F1 inflation. Output duplicates, out-of-range timestamps and missing cases are failures under a frozen policy.

comparators: Training-only optical median/MAD threshold plus refractory control, a fixed matched-filter threshold, and a separately pinned VolPy trace/spike pipeline. Full-video VolPy receives richer inputs and must be labelled an auxiliary richer-input reference, unless its trace-only mode can genuinely be matched.
negative_controls: Within-movie optical-to-patch block reassignment with nuisance/duration preserved.
Polarity/camera/exposure metadata-only prior, fixed output-rate baseline.
Event matching boundary and duplicate controls before any scientific score.
leakage_controls: Patch channel, spike-triggered ROI/denoising/template selection, or labels in cell filenames may reveal answers.
Repeated movies of the same cell and shared mice can leak across folds.
Threshold tuning on held patch traces or evaluator use of held spikes to trim optical intervals invalidates equal-input evaluation.
Pretrained VolPy/CaImAn denoising/model versions may have seen this public collection.

provenance.verified_source_facts: The version1 collection describes12 cells and13 articles, including a usage notebook, with optical sampling400Hz or1kHz. Its methods describe7 mice, while the twelve cell-article titles contain six distinct animal-name tokens; biological reconciliation is required. One inspected cell archive alone is5,444,944,707 bytes. The guide and that cell declare CC BY4.0; remaining11 cell licenses and file lists are uninspected.
provenance.rights_access_version: Collection DOI v1 and each article v1 provide stable source identities. Guide and one cell CC BY4.0 verified; remaining cells, code reuse, archive identity/size totals and notebook dependencies still require review. Acquire originals externally; no repackaging authorized by this dossier.

resources: Metadata-proven lower bound is5.44GB for one of12 cells; full imagery total is unknown and must be summed before intake. Complete extracted traces are much smaller than movies but require authentic provenance. Prospective streamed optical extraction: workstation,16–32GB RAM, CPU hours to days depending totalframes; optional GPU VolPy training not required by direct comparison and not selected. Trace threshold scoring should be CPU-scale; all costs unmeasured.
remaining_gates: Root duplicate/source-family adjudication across both tracks and held reserves.
Exact full scientific membership and immutable file identities before acquisition.
Rights and permitted assessment/redistribution checked for every selected release component.
Authentic schema/clock/unit/label QC, reference qualification, independent grader review and all controls.
Model exposure audit and defensible outer assessment; public historical labels are development material.

paired_access_conditions.direct: No-tools inference on the complete canonical signal packet and target-free permitted context.
paired_access_conditions.numerical: Numerical tools on the identical packet. Frozen-program versus per-case adaptive tool use is separately logged within this task.
paired_access_conditions.specialist: Audited fixed feature extractor or train-only physiological model on identical information; trained model access is an assistance condition, not evidence of unaided understanding.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Same case IDs, inputs, units, masks, training/calibration exposure, protected answers, and transform support. Raw versus lossy derived signals are separately labelled input substrates; no equivalence assumed. Richer-input specialists are auxiliary.
paired_access_conditions.interpretation: Association, tool use, public exposure and physiological understanding remain separate. No model campaign is selected.

machine_output.predictions: Sorted predicted spike timestamps per complete movie/cell in the authenticated native clock; confidence optional, with threshold selected only on TRAIN/DEV.
machine_output.score_rows: One-to-one matched TP/FP/FN at5ms; aggregate counts within complete movie/cell and authenticated animal. No extra reward for empty/empty windows. Timing errors and false alarms remain.
machine_output.coverage: All12 cells/all movies at400Hz or1kHz; seven-paper-mouse versus six title-token map unresolved. Patch-derived truth, ROIs and preprocessing choices remain evaluator-protected.

distinctness: Electrically verified spike timing from label-independent optical voltage traces. Existing CellMincer asks paired-image denoising/fidelity on PairedBeRST; this different declared signal-to-target task is independently interpretable even if upstream acquisition reuse is later found.
stronger_claim_hold: A derived-trace task does not demonstrate raw-video understanding. Full-video VolPy/CaImAn assistance is auxiliary unless information parity is established.
